headline: Vessel Services request for review and possible action, plus financial and facilities updates.
summary: The agenda includes a fish exchange report and a general manager update. Public comment is listed for the Vessel Services request, and the group may meet in executive session to review confidential lease information.
items: Financial update by Kaela Gonzalez, Program Coordinator
Facilities update by Phil DiPierro, Project Manager
Portland Fish Exchange Manager's Report by subcommittee chair Matt Moretti
Review and discussion of Vessel Services request, an action item with public comment
Verbal staff update by Heather Moretti, Waterfront Coordinator
Other items not on the agenda
